scope: Primary-report and selected code review; no data rerun, meanings, images, sealed sources, or experimental selection. Eleven retained facts. Branch comparison only for the six named structural documents across all locally visible heads/remotes; not an audit of every file or remote freshness.

facts.retained_fact: The fixed whole-form predictive gain is spread over many forms.
